propositions: The scc metric backend invokes scc without the --by-file flag, causing the JSON output to contain empty Files arrays for all language summaries.
_scc_files consumes only per-file entries from the Files arrays and therefore yields no results, preventing the threshold loop from executing and blocking all file match emissions.
A present scc binary over a repository containing files above the 800-LOC cutoff currently returns zero matches instead of emitting a normalized match for each over-cutoff file.
The analogous code-health adapter defect was previously fixed (rapid-cuboid-velvetcrab), establishing that per-file scc consumers must explicitly request per-file JSON output.
Adding the --by-file flag to the scc invocation at engine_b_backends.py:376 restores the documented detector contract without changing thresholds, Code field parsing, or fail-open semantics.
